summary: Full E2E backend + frontend testing of Blue Intelligence Maritime OSINT Swarm. 13/13 backend pytest checks pass. Frontend loads with all expected data-testid selectors, EN/FR i18n works, settings persist, audit KPIs (7 extractions / 100% success / 6 projects mapped) render correctly, dark Leaflet map renders cyan cluster markers, project list shows 6 The Ocean Foundation projects, destructive confirm dialog was cancelled and projects preserved. No full swarm redeploy was executed (as requested — TinyFish credits preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~360 lines with route handlers, force-extract logic and static i18n manuals mixed together. Consider splitting into routers/ (projects.py, swarm.py, settings.py, audit.py) and moving MANUALS dict to a separate module for maintainability.
GET /api/projects and /api/funders both do .to_list(5000) with no server-side pagination; will not scale beyond a few thousand projects.

read_settings() masks anthropic/tinyfish keys by setting them to empty strings; a client-side PUT that echoes them back could accidentally erase stored keys. Current code guards by dropping empty strings in write_settings — good — but this contract is fragile; consider a dedicated /settings/keys endpoint or never returning the key field at all.
swarm.status() truncates agents to 20; if UI ever wants historic run visibility a paginated /swarm/history would help.
pipeline._process_url stores lat/lon as floats without validating snap_to_ocean success; if snap fails snapped stays False silently — worth logging.
No structured logging or request ID; debugging distributed swarm failures relies on print-style logs.
seed_data_creation: None. Preserved existing 6 The Ocean Foundation projects and 7 telemetry entries. Did NOT call DELETE /api/audit or DELETE /api/projects. Did NOT redeploy the swarm.

It intentionally skips DELETE /api/audit and swarm deploy to protect user data and TinyFish credits. Frontend testids in App.js/components/*.js match spec.
